title: Who Moved My $Z$ Boson? Revealing Resonance Features Inside a Neural Network
abstract: arXiv:2611.26291v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Methods used in mechanistic interpretability have revealed human-aligned concepts inside language and image models. In this paper, we search for physics concepts inside a neural a generative collider physics model trained on real LHC data (ShellFlow). We discover features inside ShellFlow that represent resonances, such as the $Z$, $J/\psi$, and $\Upsilon$. The network was never told which muons come from a resonance, it was only trained to generate the kinematics of the final-state particles. We use these features to alter aspects of the $Z$ boson: we change its mass between $\sim80$ and $105$ GeV, and removing such a feature from the neural network produces a broader $Z$ peak. In both cases the rest of the invariant mass spectrum remains mostly unchanged. The feature was built from the gradients of the neural network, and its selectivity was built using pattern recognition methods. A generative particle physics model trained on unlab

translated_title: 谁动了我的 $Z$ 玻色子？揭示神经网络内部的共振特征
translated_abstract: 机械可解释性领域的方法已经在语言和图像模型中揭示出与人类对齐的概念。在本文中，我们在一个基于真实LHC数据训练的神经生成式对撞机物理模型中搜索物理学概念。我们在ShellFlow内部发现了代表共振的特征，例如 $Z$ 玻色子、$J/\psi$ 和 $\Upsilon$。该网络从未被告知哪些μ子来自共振，它仅被训练用于生成末态粒子的运动学量。我们利用这些特征来改变 $Z$ 玻色子的某些属性：我们将其质量在约80至105 GeV之间进行调整，而从神经网络中移除该特征则会产生更宽的 $Z$ 峰。在这两种情况下，不变质量谱的其余部分基本保持不变。该特征由神经网络的梯度构建，其选择性则通过模式识别方法构建。一个基于未标注（数据训练的生成式粒子物理模型……）※摘要在此处被截断
tldr: 该研究在基于真实LHC数据训练的生成式对撞机物理模型ShellFlow中，通过梯度与模式识别方法发现了代表 $Z$ 玻色子等共振的内部可解释特征，并证明可以操控这些特征来改变 $Z$ 玻色子的质量和峰宽而不影响不变质量谱的其余部分。
en_tdlr: This work discovers interpretable resonance features (such as the $Z$ boson) inside a generative collider physics model trained on real LHC data, and demonstrates their causal role by manipulating the feature to alter the $Z$ boson's mass and peak width while leaving the rest of the invariant mass spectrum unchanged.
